crossRefs.note: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.
translations.bsb: Jesus answered them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.
translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
translations.asv: Jesus answered and said unto them, I did one work, and ye all marvel because thereof.
